title.narrative: Strengthening the HIV and TB National Response - Egypt (01-Apr-2022-31-Mar-2025)

description.narrative: Egypt, TB/HIV, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Egypt Co)This program has the following goals: Reduce TB incidence by 50% by 2025 compared to 2015 (15 cases / 100 000 population). Reduce the number of TB death by 75% by 2025 compared to 2015. To reduce catastrophic cost on patients and their families from 24% in 2019 to 0% by 2025. “End the AIDS” epidemic as a public health threat by 2030 within the context of ensuring healthy lives and promoting well-being for all at all ages. The objectives of this program are: To strengthen the existing system to provide universal access to TB prevention, care and control by increasing access to newer diagnostic and treatment services.. To achieve reduction in new HIV infections, including among key populations. To reduce TB deaths among people living with HIV. To ensure that 95% of people living with HIV know their virus status. To ensure that 95% of people diagnosed with HIV are receiving ART. To ensure that 95% people diagnosed with HIV on treatment achieve viral load suppression
